item.description: Responsible AI scholarship has found that ethical principles are frequently not reflected in AI design and development. item.description: This chapter addresses the central reproducibility problem of research with large language models. item.description: Efficient video human pose estimation must balance localisation accuracy, motion quality, and energy cost.
